descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Role: SAP S/4 HANA ABAP Developer for Application Management (L1 & L2) 
 Location: Bucharest OR Timisoara OR Open for Entire Romania - Hybrid/Remote 
 Type: Full-time (Not available for Contracts) 
 Salary: Negotiable 
 Mandatory Skills: SAP ABAP Development (Frontend: UI5/FIORI, Backend: ABAP-OO, OData, CDS), SAP Application Support (L1 & L2 Tickets) 
 Hands-on exposure in one or more areas: CDS views, OData, SAP Gateway, Fiori/UI5, or integration interfaces 
 About the Role: 
 · Client supports an international, globally distributed software vendor in his cloud service area with application management services. ·
 On top of the latest S/4HANA ABAP technology stack (UI5, ABAP Objects, CDS, oDATA, RAP), custom-built applications will be developed and supported in a DevOps approach.
 · The business processes as implemented in the custom-built ABAP applications are related to data centre management, data centre operations, IT asset management, and ITIL Configuration Management Database (CMDB). · We are looking for additional support to enhance the existing team.
 Roles & Responsibilities: 
Handle development requests, service requests and incidents (2nd level) based on ITIL methodologies
Analyze and debug in the ABAP stack, including dumps/logs/traces and Gateway/OData issue analysis
Implement small enhancements and bug fixes
Troubleshoot Fiori/UI5-driven processes and OData services (v2/v4), including integrations with internal and external systems
Conduct performance analysis and optimizations (e.g., Open SQL, CDS annotations, paging, indexes)
Contribute to cloud-readiness of applications (e.g., ABAP clean code, stateless design, external configuration, logging/tracing, OData v4, ABAP Cloud/BTP)
Ensure quality: ABAP Unit tests, documentation, and knowledge base contributions
Collaborate with development, architecture, product team and drive continuous improvement (e.g., automation of recurring tasks)
 Required Skills: 
3-6 years of experience in ABAP development on the latest S/4HANA ABAP technology stack (Frontend: UI5/FIORI, Backend: ABAP-OO, oData, CDS)
Solid ABAP OO fundamentals; confident in debugging and Open SQL
Hands-on exposure in one or more areas: CDS views, OData, SAP Gateway, Fiori/UI5, or integration interfaces (e.g., ABAP Proxy/RFC)
Basic understanding of transports (CTS/gCTS), authorisations, and user concepts
Structured approach to the ticket lifecycle
Strong presentation and communication skills in English.
 What the candidate can expect: 
Guided learning on the latest SAP stack: RAP, ABAP Cloud/BTP, modern OData, Fiori
Clear growth path: from operations-focused developer to full-stack SAP cloud developer to lead architect to technical lead managing a team of developers
Modern toolchain: ADT/Eclipse, Git/gCTS, abapGit, ATC, CI/CD, ticketing and monitoring
Tangible impact: keep productive services stable, reduce MTTR, improve performance, and advance cloud-readiness.
